Biostatistician - Psychoneurobiology of Eating and Addictive Behaviours

REF. 26-159_SS_FF

 

About the research group

Clinical Psychology Department (Hospital Universitari de Bellvitge), Psychoneurobiology of Eating and Addictive Behaviours Research Group. The research group is focused on conducting high-quality biomedical and clinical research through the application of advanced statistical methods, data analysis and evidence-based approaches. The unit collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to support research projects, data management, quality improvement initiatives and scientific dissemination.

 

About the role

The successful candidate will support the statistical and methodological aspects of biomedical research projects. Responsibilities will include data management and analysis, database quality control, statistical modelling, preparation of reports and collaboration with researchers in the interpretation and presentation of results. The position offers an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in applied biostatistics within a leading research environment.

 

Job requirements

Professional experience

  • Experience in quantitative data analysis through academic projects and research activities.
  • Experience supporting research and quality improvement projects.

Education and training

  • Bachelor's Degree in Statistics
  • Additional training in advanced quantitative methods 

Technical & soft skills

  • Knowledge of R
  • Team player with ability to learn new skills, tasks and technologies and teach other

Languages

  • Very good written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Native or fluent Spanish and Catalan

 

We will value, but not required

  • Previous experience in healthcare, clinical or biomedical research environments.
  • Knowledge of database packages (RedCap, ACCESS, Oracle, )
  • Knowledge of general statistical packages (SAS, SPSS, Stata, Mplus, )

Our institute

IDIBELL is a research center that integrates the biomedical research of the Bellvitge University Hospital (HUB), the Catalan Institute of Oncology (ICO), and the University of Barcelona in the Bellvitge Campus (UB), and the Viladecans Hospital (HV). The research focuses of IDIBELL are cancer, neuroscience, translational medicine and regenerative medicine. Research, innovation and society are the pivots on which researchers work every day in order to improve the quality of life of citizens.
